name: manual_aa61b7
claim: An absent registry entry means unknown, not none; a maintenance job must never write a destructive default derived from missing metadata

decisions.notes: The weekly tag writer filtered SOURCE_TAGS (custom/revised) out of the desired set and, finding no provenance entry, wrote 'tags: []' over 'tags: [custom]' on agent/paseo-help and agent/paseo-plugin. It reported the condition as a warning gap while performing the data loss as a write.
